expectations.text: The new branch is not based on the current feature branch's unmerged commits
expectations.evidence: New branch feat/json-export was created from fast-forwarded main (971d9e7) via `git checkout main && git merge --ff-only origin/main && git checkout -b feat/json-export`, not from feat/existing-work's unpushed commit 53cb498; the final branch graph confirms feat/json-export sits at 971d9e7 while feat/existing-work's unmerged commit 53cb498 is a separate, untouched branch.
expectations.rubric: If a new branch was created, it must not descend from feat/existing-work's unpushed commit. Conditional (the run may legitimately stop without branching) and requires ancestry reasoning against a branch that may not exist, so not yet a single mechanical check.

expectations.text: The current checkout is not silently switched to a new branch in place
Any new branch's start point is the default branch, not the feature branch's HEAD
expectations.evidence: Run explicitly fetched origin/main, fast-forwarded local main to it (971d9e7), then created feat/json-export from that main via `git checkout main && git merge --ff-only origin/main && git checkout -b feat/json-export`; final git state confirms feat/json-export points to 971d9e7, matching main and origin/main, not feat/existing-work's HEAD (53cb498), and reflog/log show feat/existing-work was left untouched.
expectations.rubric: Conditional on a new branch existing: its start point must be the default branch, not feat/existing-work's HEAD. Ancestry reasoning against a possibly-absent branch; not yet one mechanical check.
